questions: Did the tremor begin suddenly, over a period of days or weeks?
Does your head ever involuntarily turn or tilt to one side, even when it is not trembling?
Do you have neck pain, stiffness, or muscle tightness?
Can lightly touching your chin, cheek, or the back of your head temporarily reduce or stop the tremor?
Is the tremor absent when you are asleep?
Do your hands also tremble when you hold them out, use them, or write?
Does the tremor occur in your legs or anywhere else?
Does alcohol noticeably reduce the tremor?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor?
Did the tremor start after beginning or increasing a medication?
Have you had other new neurological symptoms, such as slowness, stiffness, imbalance, weakness, numbness, or changes in speech?
Does the tremor vary markedly depending on your attention, stress, or emotional state?
Did the tremor begin during or shortly after a major period of psychological stress?
